description:
A backup software for your Mac or Windows PC.


Bug Fixes
- Fixed an active backup plan disappearing from the Back Up list, from the Arq Monitor menu, and from "arqc" when another backup plan record referred to the same backup set. This could happen after adopting a backup set, or after re-pointing a backup plan to a different destination over time. The plan kept backing up on schedule throughout — only its display was affected, and no backup data was lost.
